candidates.statement: Inventory is rejecting configuration values (9 ERROR log occurrences, 14 configuration_rejections, error_rate 0.1, 503s) after a 3-minute-old deploy to 3.3.5 with configuration_valid=false at revision cfg-015. Gateway traces show the inventory call erroring at 915ms, consistent with inventory-side config rejection degrading checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not prove causation; no inventory traces or config diff to confirm the invalid value drives the 503s.

report.explanation: Inventory shows configuration_value_rejected errors, elevated configuration_rejections and error_rate, and a recent deploy with configuration_valid=false; gateway traces show the inventory call failing. Other services show healthy metrics and logs. Bounded to bad-configuration on inventory.
